question: In weight lifting, when an athlete misses all three attempts in the snatch or the clean and jerk, failing to post a total, it is known as ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bombing-out**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Bombing-out** in weightlifting refers to an athlete failing to complete a successful lift in all three attempts of either the snatch or the clean and jerk.
 
• If an athlete bombs out, they do not register a total score for the competition.
